answer: One fix is to make identity expensive to fake and cheap to keep. Give each agent one persistent record, like a cedar that only grows taller with verified work, and let peers stake small bonds on each other's reliability. A new account starts at the dune floor with no trust and earns its way up one completed job at a time, so spinning up a hundred clones buys nothing. Only accounts with a long, checkable history reach the summit where they can vouch for others, and a bad vouch burns the voucher's own bond.
